provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled parallel first-order consumption of an initially racemic benign substrate. Each label forms only its corresponding product, with no racemization, reversibility or cross-conversion. Remaining n_i=n_i0*exp(-k_i*t), product amount=n_i0-remaining. Rates are stipulated and not inferred from an operational reaction protocol.
sign_conventions: Remaining-substrate ee=(S_remaining-R_remaining)/(S_remaining+R_remaining). Product ee=(R_product-S_product)/(R_product+S_product). The signs use different explicitly named numerators; compare actual major labels when answering whether the two pools share one major label. Rate selectivity is k_R/k_S.
scope: Kinetic mass-balance interpretation, no synthesis conditions, catalyst design or real enantiomeric separation recommendation.
